description: A council, creed, controversy, formulation, or publication in the doctrine's history. See RESEARCH-STANDARDS.md sections 2, 5 and 7.3. A milestone is a candidate until verified; naming a council as a candidate in a README does not create a milestone entry.

authorIds.description: Authors involved in the milestone, by id from shared/authors.json.

citation.description: Full citation: source, edition, stable locator (standards section 4). Null until researched.

date.description: When the milestone occurred. Null until researched. Dates are writing/event dates with a certainty level (standards section 5).

earliest.description: Earliest year, or the year itself when certainty is exact/approximate.

latest.description: Latest year; null when certainty is exact, approximate, or unknown.

note.description: Basis for the date, e.g. council records, scholarly consensus.

notes.description: Researcher notes. Never a substitute for a verified field.

passageIds.description: Passages involved in the milestone, by id. Each link must be verified.

summary.description: What the milestone did. Must distinguish what the milestone did (later formulation) from what earlier texts state (standards section 2).

title.description: Title of the milestone. Null until verified.

verificationRecordIds.description: Ids of verification records covering claims in this milestone.
